name: Trang Truong
title: Business Data Analytics Student and AI/ML Researcher

about.greeting: Hi, my name is Trang Truong.
about.current_role: I am an undergraduate researcher at BullyBlocker, where I optimize LLM-based cyberbullying detection, build explainable NLP workflows, and design AI systems for safer online interactions.
about.specialization: My work focuses on machine learning, NLP, retrieval-augmented systems, multimodal AI, and practical deployment using tools like FastAPI, Docker, FAISS, Hugging Face, and cloud APIs.
about.education: I am pursuing a B.S. in Business Data Analytics at Arizona State University with a 3.83 GPA and coursework in machine learning, software engineering, system design, and social media mining.
about.competitive_programming: Recent highlights include winning Rice Datathon 2026 with EduTag and winning Vandyhacks XII with WALL-E, two projects centered on real-world AI systems.
